title: Champion Tennis is an upcoming quirky little 3D sports sim with one big problem
summary: If you've been looking for a new tennis-based sports sim to play, then you're not exactly spoilt for choice. Football and baseball get plenty of attention, but tennis? Not so much. That is, unless you hop into Champion Tennis, the new game from Mnshine studio, now available to purchase on Google Play, with a free demo on the Chinese platform TapTap! Champion Tennis is a surprisingly quirky arcade tennis sim that has you making your way through individual cups while gathering absurd upgrades. You'll gather skill cards offering various upgrades and moves to help you out, even letting you hurl lightning, ice and meteor shots at your opponent. And with a huge number of cups, AI opponents and other content, it seems almost perfect. ... [MORE]

title: Hay Day sees Most Haunted Host Yvette Fielding appear as part of Halloween celebrations
summary: Hay Day is continuing its suite of recent celebrity collabs that have featured the likes of Gordon Ramsay and Joe Jonas, tying it into the spookiest month of the year. As part of their Halloween event, Hay Day has teamed up with Yvette Fielding, the host of the long-running UK ghost-hunting show Most Haunted. The collaboration sees Fielding lend her likeness, which has graced Most Haunted on and off since 2002, to a new advert featuring her investigating Cogges Manor Farm and inviting the spectral entity haunting it to play Hay Day. Naturally, that ties into the new, spooky update arriving in-game. ... [MORE]

title: Cult Vacui has you racing against time in a tense, terrifying point-and-click adventure
summary: It seems as though nothing good comes of heading to remote Scottish islands. And Cult Vacui is only further evidence of that, as the horror point-and-click adventure, with the constantly ticking clock, arrives on iOS and Android! So step in, get moving and watch the minutes fly by towards true terror. Cult Vacui sees you step back in time to the 19th century, as you arrive on the remote island of Barra in Scotland, to take up your role as new caretaker of the Gladstone summer estate. Fortunately, you arrive after the friendly local cult has already conducted their ritual, but unfortunately, it's not quite over yet, and you only have a mere few hours to prepare for the final act. ... [MORE]

title: Mini Motorways celebrates seven years by taking you to Rome in next update
summary: Dinosaur Polo Club have two things to be proud of: one of the best studio names out there, and seven years of continuous support for their hit traffic puzzler Mini Motorways. Now, as part of The MIX Fall showcase, the studio has unveiled the latest destination for Mini Motorways, Rome. Aside from the city of Rome itself, the update, which is planned for this winter, will also add new achievements, daily and weekly challenges, as well as the Continue in Creative Mode option. Meaning even if you flub the maps' challenges, you can continue crafting your own creation without limits. ... [MORE]

title: Maneki Mania turns petting a lucky cat into an endless fortune machine
summary: You’ve almost certainly seen one. A little gold cat sat by the till in a takeaway, one paw going up and down, doing its best to bring the owner some luck. Maneki Mania takes that cat, puts it in a shrine, and hands the paw over to you. Maneki Mania is an incremental from Lianes8 Studio. You pet the cat, koban pop out with a bit of confetti, and every pet also charges a fortune meter. Fill it and a lever lights up, which spins a set of charm slots. Pairs pay, three of a kind pays five times a pair, and a full board of koban is the jackpot. ... [MORE]

title: Seolhwa Dungeon turns Korean folktales into deadly roguelike rules
summary: Beetlejuice is summoned only when you take his name three times. Jeoseung Saja, the grim reaper in Seolhwa Dungeon, works the other way round. He calls your name once for every turn he can see you, and on the third call, you’re the one who disappears. That’s a fair taste of how Seolhwa Dungeon, a turn-based roguelike RPG, goes about things. Seolhwa means folktale in Korean, and solo devel Sungki Soft has built the whole dungeon out of them, so the stories aren’t just set dressing. They’re the rules. ... [MORE]

title: Hoshikage is a one-fingered sword-battling action game that lets you feel like an anime heroine
summary: I think it's safe to say that Asia's swordplay has completely supplanted anything Europe or beyond has to offer. After all, a shiny sword from Camelot isn't quite as cool as cutting the clouds in flight, or whatever your metaphor of choice is. And newly released sword battler Hoshikage lets you feel exactly like that wuxia, anime-style hero effortlessly taking on your enemies. What makes Hoshikage stand out is that you use only a single finger to play. With hordes of enemies attacking you left and right, you need to parry and deflect their blows in particular sequences, leaving them staggered. Once all your foes are seeing spots before their eyes, it's time to unleash an Issen, a devastating blow to cut them all down at once. ... [MORE]

title: Wavy Road is a quirky little endless runner that's launching with its own Halloween event
summary: Endless runners are a constant favourite on mobile, and for good reason. They're easy to pick up, hard to put down, and, depending on the developer, can have all kinds of interesting twists on a simple format. And that's what Wavy Road is setting out to achieve, with its quirky endless runner action coming to iOS on October 21st. Wavy Road stands out because you aren't following a track, but laying it yourself. As you move your vehicle, the road ahead will similarly twist and turn, with the objective being (obviously) to avoid obstacles. As you twist the road, you'll need to watch what your vehicle of choice is doing, and keep it on track for as long as possible. ... [MORE]

title: Heat: Pedal to the Metal brings fast-paced, nitro-fuelled racing board game action to mobile
summary: Nowadays we're used to racing games being all about high-octane, fast-paced and flashy visuals. But Heat: Pedal to the Metal, the upcoming digital adaptation of Asmodee's hit board game, takes a different tack. Instead of split-second decisions, you'll weigh your moves carefully in high-octane races that can still twist on a dime. Heat: Pedal to the Metal is a card-based board game that sees you playing as drivers in the heyday of 1960s racing. High speed, low safety, and four different maps covering recreations and amalgamations of iconic tracks across the USA, Britain, Italy, France and Germany. You'll need to decide when to accelerate, when to maintain your position and when to go for that crucial overtake. ... [MORE]

title: RuneScape Reignited axed by development team but temporary free membership will go ahead
summary: It was one of the more surprising and divisive reveals at RuneFest 2026. RuneScape Reignited was a separate, siloed-off economy where players began at level three and could explore Gielinor at their own pace. While the excitement was palpable, so was the discontent, and now, RuneScape Reignited has been shelved for good. As explained by Mod Ryan, RuneScape Reignited's rather lacklustre response from existing fans, especially regarding a separate economy and other issues, has led to them axing plans to launch it this December. It's an important step from the folks at Jagex, who have been working to regain player trust throughout 2026 with their Road to Restoration roadmap. ... [MORE]

Case of the Golden Idol should need little introduction, but for those of you dipping your toes in for the first time, here's a brief overview. Following the titular cursed artefact across decades of crimes in the 18th century, you work to investigate mysterious deaths surrounding the Golden Idol, using its distinctive 'fill in the blanks' deduction system. ... title: Absolum debuts new mobile gameplay trailer with look at customisable controls
summary: While Golden Axe may be the name on everyone's lips with its new animated series, if you fancy less self-referential humour and more proper side-scrolling action, Absolum might be what you're after. Now, you can get a look at Absolum's mobile controls in detail with the latest gameplay reveal trailer! The most interesting thing that fans of Absolum, and newcomers alike, will be glad to see is the amount of customisability on offer. Being a fast-paced modern beat 'em up, you want a great degree of control over your character, so it's no surprise that's what Absolum is offering with fully customisable control placement. ... [MORE]

title: Clash Royale is the next Supercell hit to come to tabletop, with an upcoming Kickstarter project
summary: What's old is new again, and nowadays the humble board game has become something of a staple. Heck, even the biggest developers on the planet are getting in on it! Because Supercell, not satisfied with bringing Clash of Clans to players worldwide, are also set to launch a new Kickstarter for a Clash Royale board game later this year! Clash Royale: The Grand Arena sees Supercell once again teaming up with Maestro Media, the company that also helped bring Clash of Clans: The Epic Raid to kitchen tables worldwide. The Grand Arena looks to adapt the tower defence gameplay from the original, with two lanes and expanding decks of characters and upgrades as players compete to outsmart one another. ... [MORE]
